newsitem.title: TAIWAN: FORECAST-Taiwan Q4 current account - Reuters Poll.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Taiwan Q4 current account - Reuters Poll.

text.p: The following Reuters Poll of Taiwan economists gives their projections for Taiwan's current account balance in the fourth quarter of 1996.
The figures were tentatively scheduled for release by the central bank after 0800 GMT on February 20.
Note: Figures in billions of U.S. dollars.
The poll results produced an average forecast for a current account surplus of US$2.995 billion for the fourth quarter.
The current account in the third quarter showed a surplus of US$3.950 billion, while a year earlier in the fourth quarter of 1995 the current account had a surplus of US$3.459 billion.
The current account statistic mainly includes merchandise, services and income balance.
Taiwan in recent years usually has had a surplus in merchandise and income, but a deficit in services.
Economists said a fourth-quarter merchandise trade surplus of some US$4 billion should keep the current account surplus at a comparatively high level in recent quarters.

"Usually, a single quarter's service deficit would be slightly higher than US$2 billion, offsetting the fourth quarter's considerable merchandise trade surplus of US$4 billion," said Capital Securities economist Wang Chia-yuan.
